Info.description:
This MATLAB Project implements the workflow for Algorithm Export for Field Oriented Control of a PMSM with Quadrature Encoder (QEP).
The project has 3 steps 1. Open loop speed control 2. Calibration mode : used to calibrate position offset for QEP and ADC offset for current measurement. 3. Closed loop speed control.
The "main.c" files and the IOC file included in the project are configured for the following target-inverter combination
Target : STM32 NUCLEO-F302R8 Inverter : X-Nucleo IHM07M1
Use host model to communicate with target and to input speed reference.
